profile.headline: Engineering Manager at Houzz
profile.summary:
I am passionate about building automation tools and infrastructure. I believe well designed tools and frameworks are one of the most critical things to productivity improvement and software reliability.

I am very fortunate to be able to work on the entire software stack, from GUI, web server, middleware, all the way down to the system infrastructure level such as  database, logging, streaming, AWS, Kubernetes, and more. Through my work experience, I have gained rich experience and skills in CICD, system design. The exposure to a large number of different big systems also makes me a quick learner in picking up new things. 

I am big advocate of system reliability, performance and productivity.

positions.title: Engineering Manager / Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech lead/manager of devtools team, focus areas include Continuous Integration and Continuous  Deployment, internal tooling and Testing Infrastructure. 

hands on projects:
- Migrating Houzz web stack from AWS EC2 to kubernetes,  including kubernetes configuration management, Istio networking, resource management, performance optimization, troubleshooting and overall strategy 
- Design and Implemented canary deployment process using istio networking.  covering backend infrastructure,  load balancer, distributed system, applications deployment. 
- Releasing tooling: build release tool collaborating with Jenkins, spinnaker for  continuous build and deploy containerize services to k8s clusters
- Setup process and support for developer productivity includes development,  code validation,  staging stabilities. 
- Redefine and create product testing and release process.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and implement testing infrastructure for both current and next generation social graph database. The infrastructure covers important aspects of a graph database ranging from code coverage, functionality, data correctness, integration to performance and reliability. In addition to implementing powerful testing hooks in the database, various open source tools such as Hadoop, Valgrind, and Hudson/Jenkins are well leveraged.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer in Test
positions.description: Work on one of the core cloud systems.  Build a suite of test tools.  Develop and enhance automation frameworks.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Develop Windows and Web applications development using latest technologies; solid foundation in n-tier, business object, design patterns and general OOP

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Enterprise level Windows and Web applications development using latest.Net and web technologies

positions.title: Software Quality Engineer
positions.description: Worked on Data Mining product in Microstrategy Business Intelligent platform. Developed and use various tools such as Rational Robot, Nunit to perform automation testing to ensure the quality of product in aspects of functionality, stability, compatibility, source code quality and performance

patents.title: PATTERN-BASED SEARCHING OF LOG-BASED REPRESENTATIONS OF GRAPH DATABASE
